purpose: Repair the third vacuity-bearing site, which v6 left live because blocker B-EIR5-02 scoped its repair instruction to the false CLAUSE rather than to the VACUITY. v6 was applied on 2026-08-12 carrying this defect.

whyV6MissedIt.theInstruction: B-EIR5-02 read 'strike "which differ above the BMP" at both sites' -- scoped to the symptom.
whyV6MissedIt.theDefect: the defect is the vacuity (naming two spellings of ONE total order as though they could differ), not the clause that justified it.
whyV6MissedIt.consequence: v5 carries THREE vacuity-bearing sites and TWO clause-bearing ones. v6 repaired exactly the two. Two independent reviewers disagreed on whether v6 was complete and BOTH were right -- one counted clause-bearing sites, the other vacuity-bearing sites. A reviewer who greps for the clause certifies a repair that left the defect standing.

howThisRepairWasScoped.basis: the VACUITY, derived by predicate over the RESOLVED v6 value -- never over v6's delta bytes, and never by grepping the clause.
howThisRepairWasScoped.measuredResult: exactly 1 vacuity-bearing leaf remains live in the applied head; the two v6 repaired no longer match because their corrected text names UTF-16 code units. That asymmetry is the intended signature.
howThisRepairWasScoped.afterThisRepair: 0 vacuity-bearing leaves in the resolved successor.

theMeasurement.method: exhaustive, not sampled: every valid Unicode scalar 0x0000-0x10FFFF excluding surrogates D800-DFFF
theMeasurement.notOnInversionCounts: utf16VsScalarInversions is an ADJACENT-PAIR count and is labelled as one. The count of all inverting PAIRS is far larger; an adjacent-pair count settles order equality and is not a claim about extent.

derivedFrom.rule: apply operations in order; every set carries its exact prior value
derivedFrom.resolutionChain: v7 -> v6 -> v5. v5 is the full-text standalone and the resolution TERMINUS. Resolve FULL-CHAIN (freeze §7.3 / CMP-IR-01).

operations.from: CHANGED IN v5, STATED PLAINLY: THIS PASS REPRODUCED THE PINNED VALUE. Serializing the pinned EP8-POS-NOMATCH-PASS bundle object with sorted keys, compact separators and ASCII output and hashing it yields exactly sha256:cc27c2beef32f3343d167c5727aa255b51884993ca416c4a862388e3be96a829 -- the value evidence.v10 pins. That is the SECOND reproduction ever; v1's was the first and no reviewer has verified either. v1's own caveats carry forward UNNARROWED: the bundle is pure ASCII, so this measurement cannot distinguish escaping policies for non-ASCII and cannot distinguish key-sort by Unicode scalar value from key-sort by UTF-8 bytes. AND THE DEPENDENCY REMAINS OPEN, because a reproduced VALUE is not a DEFINED PROFILE: 'opensip-canonical-json-v1' is still named exactly once by evidence.v10 and defined nowhere in it, and no artifact states which object it canonicalises. See independentSourceReproduction.evaluationProofBundleCasRefReproduction for the measurement.
operations.value: CHANGED IN v5, STATED PLAINLY: THIS PASS REPRODUCED THE PINNED VALUE. Serializing the pinned EP8-POS-NOMATCH-PASS bundle object with sorted keys, compact separators and ASCII output and hashing it yields exactly sha256:cc27c2beef32f3343d167c5727aa255b51884993ca416c4a862388e3be96a829 -- the value evidence.v10 pins. That is the SECOND reproduction ever; v1's was the first and no reviewer has verified either. v1's own caveats carry forward UNNARROWED: the bundle is pure ASCII, so this measurement cannot distinguish escaping policies for non-ASCII and cannot distinguish key-sort by Unicode scalar value from key-sort by UTF-16 code units. CORRECTED IN v7: v5 named the pair {scalar value, UTF-8 bytes}, which cannot differ -- measured exhaustively over all 1112064 valid Unicode scalars, ZERO inversions; UTF-8 byte order IS Unicode scalar-value order, on characters and on strings. The caveat as written was VACUOUS: it disclosed a limitation that does not exist. The pair that genuinely diverges is {scalar == UTF-8} versus {UTF-16 code units, as RFC 8785 JCS specifies}, first differing at U+FFFF vs U+10000, with settling vector keys U+E000 and U+10000 (scalar/UTF-8 emit U+E000 first; UTF-16 emits U+10000 first, its surrogate pair opening 0xD800 < 0xE000). See canonical-json-profile.v1#$.undeterminedRegister.UR-1, which remains OPEN. AND THE DEPENDENCY REMAINS OPEN, because a reproduced VALUE is not a DEFINED PROFILE: 'opensip-canonical-json-v1' is still named exactly once by evidence.v10 and defined nowhere in it, and no artifact states which object it canonicalises. See independentSourceReproduction.evaluationProofBundleCasRefReproduction for the measurement.
